cat > crowd-funding/daml/CrowdFunding.daml <<'EOF'
module CrowdFunding where

import Iou
import DA.Action

template Campaign
  with
    originator : Party
    name : Text
    description : Text
    backers : [Party]
    ious : [(Party, ContractId Iou)]
    raised : Decimal
    deadline : Time
    threshold : Decimal
  where
    signatory originator
    observer backers

    choice Invite : ContractId Invitation
      with backer : Party
      controller originator
      do
        create Invitation with originator; backer; campaignId = self

    choice AddBacker : ContractId Campaign
      with backer : Party
      controller originator
      do
        assert (notElem backer backers)
        create this with backers = backer :: backers

    choice Pledge : ContractId Campaign
      with backer : Party; iouId : ContractId Iou
      controller backer
      do
        now <- getTime
        assert (now < deadline)
        assert (elem backer backers)
        iou <- fetch iouId
        assert (iou.owner == backer)
        lockedId <- exercise iouId Lock with newLocker = originator
        create this with
          ious = (backer, lockedId) :: ious
          raised = raised + iou.amount

    choice Claim : [ContractId Iou]
      controller originator
      do
        now <- getTime
        assert (now >= deadline && raised >= threshold)
        forA ious \\(_, iouId) -> exercise iouId Transfer with newOwner = originator

    choice Reclaim : ContractId Campaign
      with backer : Party
      controller backer
      do
        now <- getTime
        assert (now >= deadline && raised < threshold)
        let backerIous = filter (\\(pledger, _) -> pledger == backer) ious
        amounts <- forA backerIous \\(_, iouId) -> do
          iou <- fetch iouId
          pure iou.amount
        forA backerIous \\(_, iouId) -> exercise iouId Transfer with newOwner = backer
        create this with
          ious = filter (\\(pledger, _) -> pledger /= backer) ious
          raised = raised - sum amounts

template Invitation
  with
    originator : Party
    backer : Party
    campaignId : ContractId Campaign
  where
    signatory originator
    observer backer

    choice Accept : ContractId Campaign
      controller backer
      do
        exercise campaignId AddBacker with backer
EOF
cd crowd-funding && daml test"

module CrowdFunding where

import Iou
import DA.Action

template Campaign
  with
    originator : Party
    name : Text
    description : Text
    backers : [Party]
    ious : [(Party, ContractId Iou)]
    raised : Decimal
    deadline : Time
    threshold : Decimal
  where
    signatory originator
    observer backers

    choice Invite : ContractId Invitation
      with backer : Party
      controller originator
      do
        create Invitation with originator; backer; campaignId = self

    choice AddBacker : ContractId Campaign
      with backer : Party
      controller originator
      do
        assert (notElem backer backers)
        create this with backers = backer :: backers

    choice Pledge : ContractId Campaign
      with backer : Party; iouId : ContractId Iou
      controller backer
      do
        now <- getTime
        assert (now < deadline)
        assert (elem backer backers)
        iou <- fetch iouId
        assert (iou.owner == backer)
        lockedId <- exercise iouId Lock with newLocker = originator
        create this with
          ious = (backer, lockedId) :: ious
          raised = raised + iou.amount

    choice Claim : [ContractId Iou]
      controller originator
      do
        now <- getTime
        assert (now >= deadline && raised >= threshold)
        forA ious \(_, iouId) -> exercise iouId Transfer with newOwner = originator

    choice Reclaim : ContractId Campaign
      with backer : Party
      controller backer
      do
        now <- getTime
        assert (now >= deadline && raised < threshold)
        let backerIous = filter (\(pledger, _) -> pledger == backer) ious
        amounts <- forA backerIous \(_, iouId) -> do
          iou <- fetch iouId
          pure iou.amount
        forA backerIous \(_, iouId) -> exercise iouId Transfer with newOwner = backer
        create this with
          ious = filter (\(pledger, _) -> pledger /= backer) ious
          raised = raised - sum amounts

template Invitation
  with
    originator : Party
    backer : Party
    campaignId : ContractId Campaign
  where
    signatory originator
    observer backer

    choice Accept : ContractId Campaign
      controller backer
      do
        exercise campaignId AddBacker with backer
EOF
